purpose: Training debug subset selected by observed reward variance; not held-out evaluation.
selection: All unique matching QA records; group_valid, termination_known, four rewards with variance, at most one truncated completion; exclude fixed evaluation500. No padding or relaxed thresholds.
notes: Logs were collected from an evolving trained policy; candidates are not guaranteed to show reward variance under the base model.
For partially truncated groups, logs contain counts but not per-completion termination flags; variance among untruncated answers is not guaranteed.
All source records and split=train preserved. Fixed500 is QA-disjoint but maps may overlap.
